attempts.summary: node1 now serves CA-verified HTTPS at https://10.100.47.10:8443/. Certificates are checked daily and shortly after boot, renewed seven days before expiry, atomically installed, and picked up through a graceful nginx reload. The public trust anchor is /etc/pki/https-rotation/ca.crt; private keys remain root-only. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were preserved.
